title: French Chickpea Terrine
description: A French-inspired terrine made with chickpeas, crispy bacon, and delicate herbs.
instructions: 2. In a large skillet, cook the bacon over medium heat until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
3. In the same skillet, cook the onion, carrot, and celery until softened. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
4. In a large bowl, combine the cooked vegetables, chickpeas, thyme, and cooked bacon.
5. In a separate bowl, beat the eggs and mix with the grated Gruyère cheese.
6. Grease the terrine mold with butter and layer the bread, vegetable mixture, and egg mixture, ending with a layer of bread.
7. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
8. Remove from the refrigerator and let sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.
10. Bake the terrine for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown and set.
11. Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
